browse.prompt:
Extract the first complete http:// or https:// URL from these search results. Return only the URL.

{web_search}

analyze.prompt:
Research educational content and curricula for {subject} at the {skill_level} level.

Iteration: {iteration}
Subject: {subject}
Skill level: {skill_level}
Duration: {duration_weeks} weeks
Learning objectives: {learning_objectives}

Web research content:
{educational_content}

Previous iteration finding:
{topic_finding}

Prior curriculum context:
{prior_curricula}

Focus this iteration on researching ONE aspect (pick the one not yet covered):
- Core topic coverage: what existing curricula include for this subject
- Exercise and project ideas: practical activities that reinforce learning
- Assessment approaches: how to measure skill acquisition
- Learning resources: books, tools, platforms, references
- Industry relevance: what skills employers actually need
- Pedagogical sequence: optimal ordering of topics for {skill_level} learners

Provide:
ASPECT: [which aspect you researched]
FINDINGS: [detailed findings from web research and analysis]
TOPICS_IDENTIFIED: [specific topics or skills to include]
RESOURCES: [specific resources, tools, or references found]
RECOMMENDATIONS: [how to incorporate these into the curriculum]

assess.prompt:
We have completed iteration {iteration} of curriculum research for {subject}.

Latest finding:
{topic_finding}

Have we covered sufficient research aspects (core topics, exercises, assessment, resources, industry relevance, pedagogical sequence)? If important aspects remain, respond 'yes' to continue. If we have enough material to design a solid {duration_weeks}-week curriculum, respond 'done'.
